propositions: The 7–21 Aug 2026 defect review identified duplicated decision logic appearing in 2–7 locations across the codebase, causing fixes to land in one copy while twins remain broken
Each consolidation child must collapse one duplicated computation into one shared module while preserving pinned observable behavior verified by named tests
Construct-uniqueness guards using conjunction of distinctive atoms or AST shapes must prevent duplicate implementations from re-emerging, with explicit escape markers for legitimate second uses

Acceptance criteria AC2 and AC3 as written measure false proxies: AC2 fails when consolidation correctly deletes duplicated test-side copies; AC3 fails because extraction necessarily increases lines in the new documented owner module
The epic contains thirteen consolidation children and nine hardening children with different guarantees; consolidation must not change pinned behavior while hardening deliberately adds behavior
